note: Force-construction constants, transcribed from the rulebook rather than scanned: these are prose tables, not stat cards, and they change only with an edition. Every entry cites its section so it can be re-checked against a new printing.

categories.label: Transport
categories.note: May only be taken alongside a Squad it can carry, and must be taken full (3.2.4).

categories.label: Generated
categories.note: Bioficer Drones and Hulks. Produced in play, never chosen when building.

categoryCap.rule: Points spent on Vanguard, on Heavy, and on Support may EACH not exceed points spent on Standard.

groupCostCap.rule: No Group may cost more than a quarter of the agreed points limit.
groupCostCap.note: A quarter of the number the players agreed, NOT the top of the band -- so the limit must be an input, not derived from the game size.

rare.rule: Only this many Rare Squads of the SAME NAME may be taken.

unique.rule: Only one Unique Squad of the same name.

variants.rule: A Squad may contain any mixture of Variants.
variants.note: Variants are chosen per MODEL, so a Squad's cost is the sum of its models.

weaponUpgrades.rule: All Units of the same Variant within a Squad must be upgraded equally.
weaponUpgrades.note: Different granularity from Variants themselves, which are per model.

sharedTransport.rule: Up to 4 Squads, plus their own Transport Squads, may share ONE larger Transport. They all form one Group.

auxiliaryTransport.rule: A hollow Transport Symbol on a Unit whose category is NOT Transport. Taken as a normal Squad, need not be full.

commanders.rule: At least one Commander must be taken. Assigned to a Unit; a Squad may contain only one.
commanders.note: Commander points count toward the total allowed points but are ignored when comparing category spend.

commandCards.rule: Optional at Skirmish size. Otherwise build a 45-card deck from the 33-card Core Set plus your faction's 33-card Faction Set, or combine both Sets for a 66-card casual deck.
commandCards.note: No card data is published anywhere, so the deck builder is deferred. The rules are recorded here so it can be built without re-reading the book.

transportSymbols.note: Hollow = capacity offered, solid = space filled. A Transport may only carry Units whose symbol SHAPE matches its own. Colour is 1:1 with shape and is decoration -- except that it is the only reliable way to tell an upright triangle from an inverted one, whose convex hulls are identical.

nestedCargoIgnored.rule: When a Transport carries another Transport, the smaller one's cargo is ignored -- it is already aboard.

entry.note: Vehicles and Infantry that do not begin the game aboard an Aircraft, or in a Transport aboard an Aircraft, always begin Reserved -- off the table until Round 2. This is why air transports earn their points, and the builder should surface it.

activation.note: A Group containing only non-auxiliary Transports cannot be picked for a normal activation and is ignored when generating Pass tokens; those Groups activate together in the Orphaned Transport step. So Group count is NOT the activation count.
